title: Elux Firerose 5000 Mixed Berries 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Elux Firerose 5000 Mixed Berries Nic Salt delivers a vibrant combination of red and blue berries for a juicy, flavour-packed vape. Sweet Strawberries provide a soft, familiar base, lifted by the tart brightness of Raspberries and the darker, more rounded notes of ripe Blueberries. The result is a balanced blend with subtle contrasts that keep things fresh and fruity from the first puff to the last. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Mixed Berries Nic Salt provides rich flavour, a tactile yet comfortable throat hit and discreet vapour production. Ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, this e-liquid works brilliantly in pod kits, vape pens and other low-powered devices. Elux Firerose 5000 Nic Salts offer a convenient way to enjoy well-known Elux flavours, and thrilling new profiles, using refillable vape kits, delivering satisfaction, value, and performance in every 10ml bottle.
